rationale: Plan addresses all required analyses: (1) denial code frequency and ranking with missingness by claim status; (2) denial rates segmented across claim type, provider specialty, network status, place of service, and authorization flag using adjudicated claims only per the retrieved skill; (3) comprehensive report documenting numerator/denominator and including small-group caveat. The adjudicated_claims denominator excludes pending claims to avoid understating denial rate, and both numerator and denominator are shown per statistical discipline requirements.
